title: fix(plugin-list): show list view sharing type and lock owner as read-only text, drop the dead Share button
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8G41SwYqhjjNvKBvSwT3KBm)_
Fixes #26844

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:列表视图工具栏上那个点了没反应的「Share」按钮,换成只读的共享状态文字(个人视图 / 共享视图),并在设置了 `sharing.lockedBy` 时显示锁图标和「Locked by 某人」。
- 为什么改:原按钮没有任何点击处理,`lockedBy` 也从未显示;仓内不存在可以打开的视图共享控件或接口,按分诊裁决「不接就不渲染按钮」。
- 风险与回滚:只动 plugin-list 工具栏这一处渲染和 10 个语言包各 3 个新键;不改 spec、不改接口;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` 的 Sharing 指示块;`ListView.test.tsx` 的 `sharing spec format — additional`;`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` 的 `sharingLockedBy`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.test.tsx -t sharing`,预期 7 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `ListView` no longer renders a ghost `Button` for `sharing`. It renders a non-interactive `span` (no role, no tabindex, not inside a button) keeping the `share-button` test id, showing the localized sharing type (`list.sharingPersonal` "Personal view" / `list.sharingCollaborative` "Shared view") and, when `sharing.lockedBy` is set, a lock icon plus `list.sharingLockedBy` "Locked by USER". The tooltip carries both, so the narrow toolbar that hides the text still says them.
- `lockedBy`: `ViewSharingSchema` declares it as a free `z.string()` described "User who locked the view configuration"; spec fixtures use ids (`user_123`, `admin`) and the plugin-list test an email. No user-lookup seam exists on this path, so it is rendered as written.
- Three new `list.*` keys in all ten `@object-ui/i18n` locale packs and in `LIST_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` (byte-identical to `en`).
- Tests: the misnamed "should display lockedBy in sharing tooltip when set" (which asserted only `Sharing: collaborative`) is replaced by real coverage: collaborative + `lockedBy` shows the owner; personal shows no owner; collaborative without `lockedBy` shows no owner; the indicator is never a button. Two existing title assertions move to the new label.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-list` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Why

Triage ruling on the card: "Show the lock owner, and either wire Share to the sharing control or do not render it." / "⛔ No dead button." No view-sharing control or endpoint was found on `main` (`ShareDialog` in components is the record share-link dialog, a different feature; the list-view registration publishes no `sharing` input), so the second branch applies.

## Acceptance notes

- `ListViewBlock.inertKeys-13074.test.tsx` CONTROL "the Share button still carries no click handler" stays green unchanged (a click on the span changes nothing); its name now says "button" for a non-button. Outside the claimed file surface, so left untouched.
- `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` row `sharing` cites "ListView.test.tsx:2572 pins the lockedBy tooltip" and the test name "should display lockedBy in sharing tooltip when set". That test is renamed here, and the old one never pinned `lockedBy`. Not edited (`packages/spec/**` out of scope); reported to the seat for routing.
- The `list.share` default key is no longer read by `ListView`; left in place (still in every locale pack).

## Verification

<details><summary>Tests and ablations</summary>

- Closure: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-list^...' build` under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 0 (5m44s).
- `vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.test.tsx packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListViewBlock.inertKeys-13074.test.tsx`: Test Files 2 passed, Tests 167 passed.
- After merging `origin/main`: `vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/plugin-list/ packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack.test.tsx`: Test Files 255 passed, Tests 3045 passed, 13 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: exit 0.
- Ablation 1 (`ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `const lockedBy = schema.sharing.lockedBy;` replaced by an `undefined`): "shows the lock owner from `sharing.lockedBy` beside a collaborative type" red, 1 failed / 6 passed; restored, blob == HEAD.
- Ablation 2 (the indicator's opening and closing `span` replaced by the old ghost `Button`): "renders the sharing indicator as read-only text, never a button" red, 1 failed / 6 passed; restored, blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Tests import `ListView` by relative path, so no dist leg.

</details>
